2609.05517.title: Emergent Goal-Directed Attention in Large Vision-Language Models
2609.05517.paper_summary: Human observers prioritize visual information according to task goals. Most computational models of naturalistic viewing are gaze-trained for free viewing, leaving open whether goal-directed attention can emerge in systems without gaze supervision. We tested two off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs), Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, on 4,887 naturalistic scenes under visual-search and free-viewing instructions. Model predictions were compared with human fixations on the same images under corresponding tasks. Both models aligned more closely with human fixations under matching goals than under mismatched goals. This crossover persisted in target-absent scenes, where alignment could not be explained by simple visual grounding, and appeared in decoder-layer readouts. Furthermore, model-thinking traces were grounded in target semantics during search and in visual prominence during free viewing. These findings show that general-purpose VLMs can generate human-aligned, goal-directed spatial priorities without gaze-specific training, informing theories of goal-directed attention and offering scalable tools for predicting where people look across tasks.
2609.05517.paper_summary_zh: 人類觀察者根據任務目標優先考慮視覺信息。大多數自然觀看的計算模型都是針對自由觀看進行注視訓練的，尚未確定在沒有注視監督的系統中是否能夠產生目標導向的注意力。我們在視覺搜索和自由觀看指令下，對兩個現成的視覺-語言模型（VLMs），Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking 和 Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it，進行了測試，涵蓋了4,887個自然場景。模型預測與人類在相應任務下對同一圖像的注視進行了比較。在匹配目標下，兩個模型與人類的注視更為一致，而在不匹配目標下則不然。這種交叉現象在目標缺失的場景中仍然存在，且其對齊無法僅通過簡單的視覺基礎解釋，並且出現在解碼器層的讀出中。此外，模型思考的痕跡在搜索過程中與目標語義相關，在自由觀看過程中則與視覺突出性相關。這些發現表明，通用的VLMs可以生成與人類對齊的、目標導向的空間優先級，而無需特定於注視的訓練，這為目標導向注意力的理論提供了信息，並提供了可擴展的工具來預測人們在不同任務中注視的位置。
2609.05517.author: Han Zhang et.al.
